name: Conviction
firstNightReminder: If either living neighbor of the holder is holding at least 1 Potion that is not an Empty Potion, replace 1 of those Potions with a Potion of Conviction. Then replace this potion with an Empty Potion.
otherNightReminder: If either living neighbor of the holder is holding at least 1 Potion that is not an Empty Potion, replace 1 of those Potions with a Potion of Conviction. Then replace this potion with an Empty Potion.
ability: Each night, a living neighbor's non-empty potion becomes a Potion of Conviction and this potion is Emptied. When this potion breaks, all Empty Potions break.
flavor: I'm quite certain drinking this was a good choice!
